meta.note: Fetched read-only from the score API. The board key is (seed, ladder_epoch); the build version is NOT part of it, which is why one board legitimately spans several builds. Scores from other epochs are not merged in -- different rules produced them.

exclusions.note: publish-live-board.py publishes one board key whole and excludes nothing. Build version is deliberately NOT a filter: a board spans builds by design, so excluding on it would drop real scores. Entries from OTHER epochs are not excluded here either -- they are simply not on this board.
